During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an '''officer''' served at [[Alliance Base 16]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gaulus/Legends|Gaulus]] with her [[Unidentified Alliance female|daughter]]. During an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack on the base, she was badly wounded and initially left to die by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Harles]] of [[Garrison Company 125a]] so that she would not be interrogated and then killed. However, she was then rescued by Harles after he allowed the woman's daughter to rig the base's [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] to blow.
